scenarios.name: constraint-inference-scope-06 Accept and reopen selected inference geometry

scenario_steps.name: Geometry in current command is selected in an editable sketch
the user choose Select
OK is disabled until an edge is selected
the user select the lower rectangle left edge
that edge is blue and OK becomes enabled
the user accept and reopen Constraint Inference Scope
Select and the highlighted left edge are retained with OK enabled
the user click the same edge again normally
the edge remains blue and OK remains enabled
the user cancel and reopen
Select and the highlighted left edge are still shown
the user choose Geometry in current command
the blue edge highlight clears and the geometry selector is disabled
the user accept
the dialog closes and Ready reports 35 dimensions needed
an active planar sketch
the user open Constrain and choose Constraint Inference Scope
Geometry in current command, All Geometry and Select are available
Geometry in current command is selected and the geometry selector is disabled
Geometry in current command is the initial scope
the user choose Select without selecting geometry
the geometry selector is enabled and OK is disabled
the user select the left edge of the exploded first placed rectangle
that edge is highlighted and OK is enabled
the user click Cancel and reopen Constraint Inference Scope
Geometry in current command is selected

scenarios.name: constraint-inference-scope-07 Accept All Geometry and restore the initial scope

scenario_steps.name: Geometry in current command is selected in the active sketch
the user choose All Geometry
the geometry selector is disabled
the user accept and reopen Constraint Inference Scope
All Geometry remains selected
the user choose Geometry in current command and accept
the original scope is restored in this session
